title: Zara bhi deer na karna Habeeb aajao
body:
khat-e-hussain ye lekar payaam aaya hai
khusha nabeeb shahadat me naam aaya hai
tumhare waaste haq se inaam aaya hai
<<MINI>>
zara bhi der na karna habeeb aajao
<<DIVIDER>>
likha hussain ne nama habeeb aajao
habeeb ibne mazahir salaam ho tum par
khuda-e-paak ki ne'mat tamaam ho tum par
maqaam khuld ho, dozakh haraam ho tum per
<<MINI>>
zara bhi der na karna habeeb aajao
<<DIVIDER>>
habeeb ham pe museebat ka waqt aaya hai
hame yazeed ne khat bhej kar bulaaya hai
hamare sar pe faqat ranj o gham ka saaya hai
<<MINI>>
zara bhi der na karna habeeb aajao
<<DIVIDER>>
habeeb saniye zehra salaam kehti hai
dil aur jaan se tumko duaye'n deti hai
tumhare aane ki har aan raah takti hai
<<MINI>>
zara bhi der na karna habeeb aajao
<<DIVIDER>>
habeeb ham se zamane ne mu ko phera hai
jaha'n ke ranj-o-masayeb ne hamko ghera hai
lab-e-furaat pe fouj-e-adu ka pehra hai
<<MINI>>
zara bhi der na karna habeeb aajao
<<DIVIDER>>
habeeb hamse hai talib yazeed bayyat ka
wo chaahta hai mitana kalaam wehdat ka
jawaab dena hai hamko ab uski taqat ka
<<MINI>>
zara bhi der na karna habeeb aajao
<<DIVIDER>>
habeeb aaj qayamat bapa hai duniya me
sawaal-e-baiyat-e-faasiq utha hai duniya me
andhera kufr ka phaila hua hai duniya me
<<MINI>>
zara bhi der na karna habeeb aajao
<<DIVIDER>>
habeeb deen khuda ka hame bachana hai
kiya jo nana se wada wohi nibhana hai
sawaal-e-baiyat-e-fasiq hame mitana hai
<<MINI>>
zara bhi der na karna habeeb aajao
<<DIVIDER>>
habeeb ahle haram bhi hai saath aaye huwe
sabhi hain khaliq-e-akber se lau lagaye huwe
zameen-e-garm pe baithe hain sar jhukaye huwe
<<MINI>>
zara bhi der na karna habeeb aajao
<<DIVIDER>>
habeeb ham pe mazalim wo dhanyenge aada
jawaan bete ko barchhi lagayenge aada
lahu sagheer ka mere bahayenge aada
<<MINI>>
zarabhi der na karna habeeb aajao
<<DIVIDER>>
habeeb ahle haram ko satanyenge zalim
hamare baad ye khaime jalayenge zalim
barehna sar inhe'n dar dar phiraynge zalim
<<MINI>>
zara bhi der na karna habeeb aajao
<<DIVIDER>>
habeeb haal kya apna baya'n kare tum se
hamari amma ki turbat bhi chhut gayi ham se
kaleja hota hai tukde hamare is gham se
<<MINI>>
zara bhi der na karna habeeb aajao
